results.title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
results.summary: Proposes PrfaaS, an architecture that selectively offloads long-context prefill to standalone compute-dense clusters and transfers KV cache over commodity Ethernet to local decode clusters across datacenters, enabled by hybrid-attention models that shrink KV cache size. Reports 54% higher throughput and 64% lower P90 TTFT on a 1T-parameter hybrid model versus a homogeneous baseline.

results.title: TokenDance: Scaling Multi-Agent LLM Serving via Collective KV Cache Sharing
results.summary: Addresses massive KV cache redundancy in multi-agent LLM workloads that use synchronized All-Gather rounds. Introduces a KV Collector for collective cache reuse and a Diff-Aware Storage that encodes sibling caches as block-sparse diffs (11-17x compression), supporting up to 2.7x more concurrent agents than vLLM.

results.title: Cache-to-Cache: Direct Semantic Communication Between Large Language Models
results.summary: Proposes C2C, a paradigm where LLMs exchange information directly through their KV cache rather than text, using a neural network to project and fuse the source model's KV cache into the target model's. Shows 6.4-14.2% higher average accuracy than individual models with an average 2.5x latency speedup.

results.title: Master KV cache aware routing with llm-d for efficient AI inference
results.summary: Details llm-d's KV cache aware routing, which maintains a global near-real-time view of KV cache block locality across distributed vLLM-based prefill and decode pods and directs requests to pods that already hold relevant context. Reports an 87.4% cache hit rate and 88% TTFT improvement for warm cache hits.

results.title: CacheSlide: Unlocking Cross Position-Aware KV Cache Reuse
results.summary: Extends vLLM's KV cache management with Chunked Contextual Position Encoding and Weighted Correction Attention to enhance positional-encoding similarity for fixed segments, enabling cross-position KV cache reuse across different contexts.
